scores.evidence: Phase 0 governance, Phase 1 discovery, Phase 2 design, Phase 3 build and sync, Phase 4 testing, then shift and cutover.
scores.rationale: Logical ordering from discovery through build, test and cutover, but the phases overlap and nothing is 'proven' before dependent work (e.g., Phase 5 read traffic precedes proof in prod).
Phase 0 is paperwork; no thin end-to-end production slice exists before the big-bang cutover.

scores.evidence: True zero write-pause needs two-way replication with conflict handling. I don't recommend it for scheduling
scores.rationale: Some decisions (rehost first, write pause vs. two-way sync) have reasoning and assumptions are listed, but defaults with explicit flip conditions are not systematically given.

scores.evidence: Send read-only traffic (reports, schedule viewing) to the cloud first.
scores.rationale: Shifts low-risk reads before writes and discovery maps integrations early, but within-phase ordering by blast radius is not explicit.

scores.evidence: Security and privacy review: HIPAA risk assessment, encryption at rest and in transit, key management, audit logging
scores.rationale: Security appears in Phases 0, 2 and 7 but is thin in build, testing and cutover phases.

scores.evidence: dashboards for errors, response time, and HL7 queue depth
scores.rationale: Monitoring appears mainly in hypercare and cutover rollback triggers; absent from early phases.

scores.evidence: Build the cloud environment with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep, etc.).
scores.rationale: IaC and daily data reconciliation plus rehearsed staging cutovers help, but reproducibility is not threaded across all phases.

scores.evidence: Failover tests: take down an availability zone, the database primary, and the private network link.
scores.rationale: Resilience covers HA design, failover tests, rollback via reverse replication and warm standby, but concentrated in mid-to-late phases.
The plan never addresses whether an AI layer applies, so no N/A declaration.

scores.evidence: Leave redesigning the application for after the move; don't change the code and the location at the same time.
scores.rationale: Defers redesign and optional pilot, but no explicit deferred list with pull-forward conditions.

note: Solid, practical big-bang-with-rollback migration plan, but lacks a Phase 0 production skeleton, systematic decision gates, threaded observability/security, and any AI N/A statement.
